note: The caller-supplied message bytes and length become the pn_bytes_t consumed by the AMQP section decoder.
When the scanned descriptor is the AMQP header section, the same input-controlled bytes are passed to the generated header-list decoder.
For a list32 encoding, the input-controlled 32-bit list byte count is read into s.
The decoder advances by the untrusted list size without first requiring that the list payload fits within the parent consumer buffer.
The subconsumer size derived from the unchecked list size is used to read the list count, which can read beyond the actual candidate buffer.
